name: Transaction monitoring coverage check
description: Monthly reconciliation that every account and payment channel (wire transfers ACH cards cash and digital wallets) feeds the transaction monitoring system

name: Scenario tuning review
description: Annual tuning of monitoring scenario thresholds with documented below-the-line testing approved by Model Risk Management

name: Alert triage ageing monitor
description: Daily report of alerts not triaged within 5 business days escalated to the AML Operations lead

name: Investigation timeliness tracker
description: Case management flags Level 2 investigations open for more than 25 calendar days so they close within 30 days

name: SAR filing deadline tracker
description: Case management raises a warning at day 25 and a breach at day 30 after the date of initial determination

name: No-suspect filing limit check
description: Weekly check that no SAR without an identified suspect exceeds 60 calendar days from initial detection

name: Continuing activity review scheduler
description: Scheduler creates a continuing activity review task every 90 days after each SAR filing

name: SAR approval sign-off
description: SAR decisions approved by the AML Officer or a delegated SAR Committee member before filing

name: Financial crime MI pack
description: Monthly MI pack to the Financial Crime Risk Committee covering alert volumes ageing SAR volumes and timeliness

name: SAR record retention
description: Restricted SAR repository retains SARs and supporting documents for five years from filing

name: Identity verification gate
description: Account opening is blocked until identity verification is complete and the evidence reference is recorded

name: Beneficial ownership capture
description: Onboarding workflow requires every individual owning 25 percent or more (10 percent for High risk) to be identified and verified

name: Complex structure review
description: Ownership charts for structures with more than three layers reviewed by Financial Crime Compliance before account opening

name: PEP enhanced due diligence approval
description: PEP relationships require Managing Director and Head of Financial Crime Compliance approval with source of wealth evidence

name: Periodic review scheduler
description: Review tasks generated every 12 24 or 36 months by risk rating and overdue reviews flagged after 60 days

name: Event-driven review trigger
description: Trigger events create a review case that must be completed within 10 business days

name: CDD record retention
description: Customer due diligence records retained for five years after the relationship ends

name: Model and AI inventory attestation
description: Quarterly attestation that every model and AI use case in production is registered with owner purpose risk tier and validation status

name: Independent validation schedule
description: Validation plan ensures Tier 1 models are validated annually and Tier 2 models every two years including bias and fairness

name: Human-in-the-loop enforcement
description: Regulated decisions supported by AI require a logged human approval with reviewer identity and rationale

name: GenAI citation and logging control
description: Generative AI applications show citations and log prompts sources responses and reviewer decisions retained for five years

name: GenAI performance monitoring
description: Quarterly retrieval accuracy citation accuracy and escalation rate monitoring for generative AI

name: Severity 1 incident escalation
description: Severity 1 incidents reported to the Head of Operational Risk and the CRO within 2 hours of identification

name: Incident logging timeliness
description: Incident system flags Severity 1 and 2 incidents not logged within 24 hours

name: RCSA completion tracking
description: Tracks annual RCSA completion and 90-day action plans for ineffective controls

name: Loss event capture
description: Operational losses of 10000 US dollars or more captured in the loss event database with monthly reconciliation to the general ledger

name: Third-party contract clause check
description: Legal checklist confirms audit rights data protection and incident notification within 24 hours in Critical and High contracts

name: Critical vendor exit plan
description: Exit plans documented for every Critical third party and tested when the service changes materially

name: Retention schedule enforcement
description: Automated retention rules apply the REC-007 schedule including 5 years for AI and model audit logs
